name: habyss
description: Habyss: one product, two apps (apps/mobile, apps/desktop) on one shared core (packages/).

scripts.mobile:check: cd apps/mobile && npm run type-check && npm run test:ci && npm run check:ui
scripts.desktop: cd apps/desktop && bun run tauri dev
scripts.desktop:build: cd apps/desktop && bun run tauri build --bundles app
scripts.desktop:dmg: cd apps/desktop && bun run tauri build --bundles app,dmg
scripts.desktop:check: cd apps/desktop && bun run check && bun run test && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
scripts.check: npm run mobile:check && npm run desktop:check
